name: Disable Context Low Warning
description: Suppresses the 'Context low (N% remaining) · Run /compact to compact & continue' statusline warning rendered by the TokenWarning component. Forces the component's early-return condition to always be truthy so it always returns null and never renders the context-low banner. Derived from the 'Context Low Warnings' patch in Haleclipse/CCometixLine's `ccline --patch cli.js` tool, but implemented as a length-neutral single-character byte swap instead of a variable-length AST rewrite.

provenance.author: Haleclipse
provenance.derived_by: Reverse-engineered from src/utils/claude_code_patcher.rs (Context Low Warnings patch); upstream does a variable-length tree-sitter AST replacement (if(true)return null;), reimplemented here as a same-length z->1 swap in the minified early-return condition of the TokenWarning component.

operations.rationale: The TokenWarning component (minified Z54) renders the 'Context low (...)' warning. Its early-return `if($.level==="ok"||z)return null` only exits when context is fine. Swapping the final disjunct `z` to literal `1` makes the condition always-truthy, so the component always returns null and the warning never displays. The full 32-byte if-statement is unique in the binary and the swap is a single char, keeping byte length identical.

archive_reason: TokenWarning anchor absent on 2.1.158; needs re-derivation
